name: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification
description: The Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) 2.0 framework measures cybersecurity maturity across three levels. It is designed to protect Federal Contract Information (FCI) and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) within the Defense Industrial Base (DIB).

domains.name: Access Control
domains.description: Limit system access to authorized users, processes, and devices

domains.name: Awareness and Training
domains.description: Ensure personnel are aware of security risks and trained in policies

domains.name: Audit and Accountability
domains.description: Create, protect, and retain system audit records

domains.name: Configuration Management
domains.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories

domains.name: Identification and Authentication
domains.description: Identify and authenticate users, processes, and devices

domains.name: Physical Protection
domains.description: Limit physical access to systems and equipment

domains.name: Personnel Security
domains.description: Screen individuals and protect CUI during personnel actions

domains.name: Risk Assessment
domains.description: Assess risk to organizational operations and assets

domains.name: Security Assessment
domains.description: Assess security controls and monitor continuously

domains.name: System and Communications Protection
domains.description: Monitor and protect communications at system boundaries

domains.name: System and Information Integrity
domains.description: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner

metadata.notes: Based on NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 for Level 2
